leadText: Mew (Japanese: ミュウ Mew) is a Mythical Pokémon and the DNA source of in the Pokémon Adventures .
plainText:
Mew (Japanese: ミュウ Mew) is a Mythical Pokémon and the DNA source of in the Pokémon Adventures .

==History==
=== ===
 
Mew debuted in A Glimpse of the Glow, where and saw it in Pallet Town and tried to catch it, but failed. It is revealed later on, that Mew inhabited the area near Pallet Town because it lacks the pollution created by humans in other areas.

Team Rocket's chase would continue all the way in The Jynx Jinx, where they attempted to regain the disc containing data on Mew's habitat and information from , but fail and are tricked into stealing an empty one she prepared. They managed to catch up to Green and her unwilling ally Red soon afterward, interrupting them when they tracked down and attempted to capture the . However, when their was able to almost succeed, Mew unleashed a powerful psychic attack that left them unconscious, and it soon escaped. The small samples of its DNA that the Rockets acquired, however, led to the creation of its .

When was explaining Mewtwo's origin to Red in And Mewtwo Too?!, Mew appeared as a silhouette. Mew was later briefly seen looking into the Indigo Plateau in A Charizard...and a Champion after Red won the Pokémon League championship and decided to return to Pallet Town with his two fellow Pokédex holders.

=== ===
 
In Mewtwo and Mew Too, Mr. Briney mentioned that he had recently arrived on Faraway Island and attempted to capture Mew. Once being alerted to his pressence, the New Species Pokémon fled the island and headed for Kanto.

Mew appeared again in Phew for Mew, where it saved Red and the people of Vermilion City from the impending crash of the Team Rocket airship. noticed this, and realized that it too had a root to trace itself back to, as it was created from Mew's eyelash.

=== ===
Mew was mentioned in The Final Battle IX, where Mr. Briney had given Ultima soil from Faraway Island, Mew's birthplace. Ultima then instructed to bring it as it will come in handy. When he arrived, he gave to , who used it to calm down the rental Pokémon under Guile's control.

=== ===
In Hoopa Distorts, Mew appeared in a flashback where Emerald explained to Steven Stone about Faraway Island and Mew's connection to all Pokémon.
 

==Personality and characteristics==
Mew is a curious and playful individual, often stopping to watch events it finds interesting. Mew is also selfless, saving Red and his Pokémon from the TR helicopter's impending crash. It also prefers areas that are untouched of pollution, such as Pallet Town.

It is able use its psychic powers in many ways such as levitating, disturbing air currents telekinetically and emitting an aura around it. Due to possessing the genetic composition of all Pokémon, soil from its birth place, Faraway Island, will calm any Pokémon down, excluding certain Legendary and Mythical Pokémon.
